summary:
JPM dominated this window with an 8-chart JPMAM valuation/concentration deck: S&P 500 P/E vs. its long-term average, the top-10 stocks' 39% market-cap share, AI now 50.8% of the index, and today's valuation matching the Feb 2020 peak.

Goldman (2) covered the underlying pace of job growth (53k estimate) and previewed next week's Communacopia Technology Conference.

Apollo's Slok (1) flagged a hot ISM Services Prices Paid print, raising September rate-hike odds ahead of next week's CPI.

BofA (1) was cited via a Suttmeier-inspired secular vs. cyclical bull/bear framework; Morgan Stanley (1) appeared in a story on its crackdown on X accounts redistributing its research.

No Neil Sethi (@neilksethi / @neilksethinew) items appeared in this window, and no duplicate charts or text were found to collapse.

**By bank:** JPM 8, Goldman 2, Apollo/Slok 1, BofA 1, Morgan Stanley 1.
